title: 第555章 我们就直接去天衍宗第554章 该我六极宫亲自去东荒走一趟了
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
就在六极宫主在西漠修士的万众期待下，带着几个合体修士向着东荒而来的时候。
烟霞峰庭院中。
三位师妹正坐在石桌旁喝水休息。
刀门的几位长老也各自找了地方坐下，揉肩膀的揉肩膀，活动手腕的活动手腕，一个个脸上都带着几分疲惫之色。
这几日来，他们从早到晚不停地压低修为与三位师妹轮番交手，虽然每次都被陆鸣用道珍补得元气满满，但精神上的疲惫却是实打实的。
而此刻，陆鸣正靠在摇椅上，端着一杯灵茶慢悠悠地喝着。
三个师妹的修为稳步上涨，自己也有一众小弟日日从旁奉承。
‘这才叫生活啊……’
陆鸣暗暗想着。
就在这时，他注意到黎川正站在不远处，时不时的望一眼自己，还一脸欲言又止的表情，脚步挪了好几次，就是没走过来。
那副扭扭捏捏的模样，简直像是动漫中的傲娇女主。
怎么了这是？
该不会要给我表白吧？
陆鸣看的疑惑，主动开口道：
“黎门主，你这是怎么了？有事说事，站那儿扭来扭去的，不知道的还以为你脚底下长虫子了。”
黎川被他说得老脸一红，终于硬着头皮走到了摇椅旁，讪讪地笑了笑：
“陆前辈……有件事，想跟您商量一下。”
陆鸣挑了挑眉：“有话直说。”
黎川深吸一口气，整理了一下思路，小心翼翼地开口道：
“是这样的……陆前辈，我们西漠的六极宫千年庆典马上就要开始了。”

“这个庆典是整个西漠千年一遇的盛事，届时西漠百余宗门都会到场。”
“在下身为血刀门门主，若是不带着大长老与二长老一同去参加，实在说不过去……所以晚辈就想，能不能请个假？”
说着，黎川生怕陆鸣拒绝似得竖起三根手指：
“就三日！前辈，我就带着大长老和二长老回去参加一下庆典，三日一过，我们马上就回来！绝不多耽搁一刻！”
嗯？
陆鸣眉头一挑有些意外。
他本以为经过这十几日来的相处，黎川已经不打算回去了，没想到这家伙还想着回去呢。
但陆鸣自然是不会答应的。
这几日来，黎川和几位长老当陪练当得相当卖力，三位师妹在他们的“磨刀石”下进步飞快，他对此非常满意。
可以说，这几个陪练是极为来之不易的。
何况，他的领域只覆盖了东荒这一片，并没有延伸到西漠去。
若是让黎川他们回了西漠，那可就相当于放虎归山了。
他们要是回去了不回来，陆鸣还真拿他们没什么办法。
想到这里，他摇了摇头，干脆利落地吐出两个字：“不行。”
黎川一听就急了，连忙上前一步，语气中带着几分恳切：
“陆前辈，这……这也不耽搁什么的呀！晚辈就带着大长老和二长老回去三日，三日后一定准时回来！晚辈可以对天发誓！”
陆鸣放下茶盏，看着他道：
“你说回来就回来？你要是不回来了呢？我上哪儿找你去？”
黎川闻言，先是一愣，随即脸上露出一种诧异的表情，连忙道：
“前辈，我怎么敢啊！就凭前辈您这实力，晚辈怎敢不回来？晚辈还怕您一怒之下杀到西漠去，把我血刀门给灭了呢！”
content_en:
Just when the Master of the Liuji Palace came to the Eastern Wasteland with a few combined monks under the great expectations of the Western Desert monks.
In the courtyard of Yanxia Peak.
The three junior sisters were sitting at the stone table drinking water and resting.
Several elders of Daomen also found a place to sit down, rubbing their shoulders and flexing their wrists, with a look of exhaustion on their faces.
In the past few days, they had kept lowering their cultivation levels from morning to night and fought against the three junior sisters in turns. Although Lu Ming used Daozhen to replenish their energy every time, their mental fatigue was real.
At this moment, Lu Ming was leaning on the rocking chair, holding a cup of spiritual tea and drinking it slowly.
The cultivation level of the three junior sisters has steadily increased, and he also has a group of younger brothers who flatter him every day.
'This is what life is called...'
Lu Ming thought secretly.
At this moment, he noticed that Li Chuan was standing not far away, looking at him from time to time, with a hesitant expression on his face. He moved his steps several times, but did not come over.
That coquettish look makes her look like a tsundere heroine in an anime.
What's wrong with this?
Are you going to confess to me?
Lu Ming looked confused and took the initiative to say:
"Master Li, what's wrong with you? You're standing there squirming around to talk about something, and those who don't know think you have bugs growing under your feet."
Li Chuan blushed at what he said, and finally walked to the rocking chair and smiled coquettishly:
"Senior Lu... I have something I want to discuss with you."
Lu Ming raised his eyebrows: "If you have anything to say, just say it."
Li Chuan took a deep breath, sorted out his thoughts, and spoke cautiously:
"That's it...Senior Lu, our Six-pole Palace Millennium Celebration in the Western Desert is about to begin."
"This celebration is a once-in-a-thousand-year event in the entire West Desert, and more than a hundred sects in the West Desert will be present."
"I am the master of the Blood Knife Sect. It would be unreasonable for me not to bring the first elder and the second elder to attend the event...so I was thinking, can I take a leave of absence?"
As he spoke, Li Chuan raised three fingers as if he was afraid of Lu Ming's rejection:
"Just three days! Senior, I will take the first elder and the second elder back to participate in the celebration. As soon as the three days are over, we will be back immediately! We won't delay for a moment longer!"
Huh?
Lu Ming raised his eyebrows in surprise.
He thought that after getting along with each other for more than ten days, Li Chuan had no intention of going back, but he didn't expect that this guy still wanted to go back.
But Lu Ming naturally would not agree.
In the past few days, Li Chuan and several elders have worked very hard as sparring partners. The three junior sisters have made rapid progress under their "whetstone", and he is very satisfied with this.
It can be said that these sparring partners are extremely hard-earned.
What's more, his domain only covers the Eastern Desert and does not extend to the Western Desert.
If Li Chuan and the others were allowed to return to the Western Desert, it would be equivalent to letting the tiger return to the mountain.
If they don't come back, there's really nothing Lu Ming can do against them.
Thinking of this, he shook his head and uttered two words clearly: "No."
Li Chuan became anxious upon hearing this and quickly stepped forward with a hint of sincerity in his tone:
"Senior Lu, this... this is not a delay or anything! I will take the First Elder and the Second Elder back for three days. I will be back on time after three days! I can swear to God!"
Lu Ming put down the tea cup, looked at him and said:
"You said you would come back right away? What if you don't come back? Where can I find you?"
When Li Chuan heard this, he was stunned for a moment, then a surprised expression appeared on his face, and he quickly said:
"Senior, how dare I! With your strength, senior, how dare I not come back? I'm afraid that you will go to the Western Desert in anger and destroy my Blood Knife Sect!"
